gate_type: ACCELERATED IMPLEMENTATION GATE — Hierarchical Scenario / Run Control (G7)
objective: Implement the smallest generic vNext run-control layer that can target a G1 Workspace or executable Scope hierarchy while preserving child runtime/domain authority: one platform-level run lifecycle service (immutable RunContextV2 per run, path-qualified targets, deterministic effective executable-scope resolution, fail-closed lifecycle guards), an execution bridge reusing G5 federation + G4 Coordinator for ASSY at legitimate natural boundaries only, additive vNext run-control endpoints under one namespace, additive G6 UI binding, and honest G4 failure semantics. No universal timestep, no fractional ASSY dwell/index, no run-id reuse for terminal runs, no fabricated replay inputs, no G8+.
explicit_non_objectives: No G9 semantic binding / PIM resolver
No fractional ASSY dwell/index or ASSY time-semantics rewrite
No AssyLineRuntime rewrite; no continuous-engine rewrite
No universal reset policy (reset stays capability-scoped)
No scenario editor; no client-side second scenario authority
forbidden_actions: Invent a universal timestep / synchronization policy
Fractionalize ASSY dwell/index or rewrite ASSY time semantics
Rewrite AssyLineRuntime or the continuous engine
Invent continuous hierarchy or run/scenario semantics
Reuse a terminal run identity for a new attempt
Fabricate replay inputs or fake readiness/replay capability
Claim rollback of already-advanced participant state
stop_conditions: Generic hierarchical step requires a new synchronization/timestep policy
ASSY must be fractionalized or its dwell/index semantics changed
Continuous runtime needs invented hierarchy or rewritten engine semantics
Reset semantics cannot stay capability-scoped without a new universal policy
Replay requires unavailable inputs that would have to be fabricated
Lifecycle design would allow terminal run identity reuse
A container-only scope must be made executable to proceed
G2 RunContextV2 identity/provenance contract must be broken
G4 failure semantics would need false rollback/transaction claims
Implementation requires G8 regression-baseline changes, G9 semantic binding, or G10 SH-WTP runtime work

acceptance_criteria.description: Valid lifecycle transitions + fail-closed invalid transitions
Immutable coherent RunContextV2; one scenario authority per run
Workspace/container target resolves deterministic descendant executable scopes (no fake container participant)
Stale/wrong run_id cannot mutate active run
Pause/resume do not advance domain time/state
Stop is terminal for that run attempt
Restart/new attempt creates a distinct run_id with source lineage
Replay creates a distinct run_id, never overwrites prior; unavailable replay explicit
ASSY hierarchical step uses only legitimate natural/common G4 boundaries; unreachable boundary fails closed
Reset capability-scoped; cannot erase/reuse terminal history incorrectly
Container-only scope never gets executable controls/participant authority
Effective target in API/UI is path-qualified
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
